hero.title: We take your investment work through to signing.
hero.lead: From Mexico we accompany investment, financing and M&A work, from origination to close, including when the deal crosses a border.

thesis.title: From thesis to signing, as one piece of work.
thesis.intro: Strategy, valuation, capital structure and negotiation are worked together, with the client, until the file is ready to sign.
thesis.principle: We stay with the client to see whether the deal makes sense, how to fund it and how to take it to signing.

capabilities.title: Origination
capabilities.text: We identify companies, assets, buyers, lenders and partners that can become an operation.

capabilities.title: Due diligence
capabilities.text: We review the financial, sector, operating and documentary side: risks, contingencies, and whether the project can hold.

capabilities.title: Valuation
capabilities.text: We value companies and assets, with models, sensitivities and the effect on the transaction.

capabilities.title: Capital structure
capabilities.text: We design debt, equity, co-investment and acquisition finance.

capabilities.title: M&A
capabilities.text: Buys, sells and target search, with negotiation through close.

capabilities.title: Fundraising
capabilities.text: We prepare the file for family offices, funds and private investors, inside the applicable rules.

capabilities.title: Real assets
capabilities.text: We structure mining, industrial, energy, infrastructure and real-estate projects, on the numbers and on the ground.

capabilities.title: Cross-border
capabilities.text: Market entry, joint ventures, local partners and execution where the operation sits.

people.name: Juan Balbontin
people.bio: In Mexico he works in real estate, infrastructure and private capital with investors, developers and operators. He comes from commercial and real-estate development inside large groups. Economics, University of Georgia. He works in Spanish and English.

people.name: Ana María Almeida Luján
people.bio: She leads due diligence and capital structure, above all in mining, industry and energy. She works with banks, funds and family offices. She chairs the financial-services section of CANACO Chihuahua. She works in Spanish and English.

people.name: Patrick Diogo
people.bio: He handles valuation and M&A, including cross-border oil and gas. Economics at the University of Lyon; specialized master’s in finance at emlyon. He works in French, English, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian.

people.name: Gregory Prudhommeaux
people.bio: He originates projects, joint ventures and capital across Europe, Asia and the Americas. Seventeen years in China; in Mexico since 2023. Conseiller du Commerce Extérieur de la France and CCI France México in Jalisco. He works in French, English, Spanish and Mandarin.
